description: Each service's own numbers, one tab per service. Counts read from a database work over any time range; panels read from traces cover the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Accounts
spec.description: Accounts by role, counted in the database.

spec.title: New accounts, 7 days
spec.description: Accounts created in the last 7 days, all roles.

spec.title: Codes mailed, 7 days
spec.description: What became of the codes mailed for a registration, an email change or a password reset. Used against mailed is the invitation or reset completion rate.

spec.title: Sign-ins by response
spec.description: Each hour's sign-in attempts by HTTP status: 200 signed in, 401 refused credentials, 429 rate-limited.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-authentication" && name = "rest.TokenCreate" } << { kind = server } | count_over_time() by (span.http.response.status_code)

spec.title: Mails sent
spec.description: Each hour's sends, by kind and status. A mail is sent once, never retried.

spec.title: Mails waiting or refused
spec.description: Mails that waited for a free sender, and mails refused because every sender was busy.

spec.title: Refused refresh tokens
spec.description: Refreshes with a revoked or unknown token. A steady stream can mean a stolen token being replayed.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-authentication" && name = "core.TokenRefresh" && status = error && statusMessage =~ "refresh token (revoked|not issued).*" } | count_over_time()

spec.title: Authorization codes issued
spec.description: Each hour's sign-ins the account platform completed for another platform, by client. A client exchanges each code within minutes, so Authorization codes exchanged follows this count.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-authentication" && name = "core.AuthorizationCodeCreate" && status != error } | count_over_time() by (span.client.id)

spec.title: Authorization codes exchanged
spec.description: Each hour's codes a client traded for its tokens. Fewer exchanges than issued codes means people sign in but never reach the client: check its callback.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-authentication" && name = "core.TokenGrant" && span.oauth.grant_type = "authorization_code" && status != error } | count_over_time() by (span.client.id)

spec.title: Refused client token requests
spec.description: Each hour's refused code exchanges and refreshes, by client and OAuth error. Ended sessions refuse a few refreshes with invalid_grant. A burst can mean replayed codes or stolen refresh tokens, and invalid_client alone a caller outside the registry.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-authentication" && name = "core.TokenGrant" && span.oauth.error != nil } | count_over_time() by (span.client.id, span.oauth.error)

spec.title: Live generations
spec.description: Generations waiting for a provider call, and those a provider works on.

spec.title: Oldest waits
spec.description: The oldest waiting generation, the oldest running call, and the longest since the sweep checked a live generation. The sweep checks each one at least every minute while it runs.

spec.title: Settled in the last hour
spec.description: Generations that reached a final status in the last hour, by reason, with those that needed a second attempt and the time from submission to settlement.

spec.title: Tokens, last 24 hours
spec.description: Tokens by model, reasoning effort and service tier: what the provider bills.

spec.title: Tokens per hour
spec.description: Input and output tokens the provider billed each hour.

spec.title: Accounts generating, 24 hours
spec.description: Accounts that ran at least one generation in the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Refusals and provider pushback
spec.description: Each hour's submissions refused by a usage cap, starts the provider turned away, and failed calls queued for another attempt.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-genai" && (name = "core.GenerationCheck(releaseStart)" || name = "core.GenerationCheck(requeue)" || (name = "core.GenerationSubmit(admit)" && status = error)) } | count_over_time() by (name)

spec.title: Provider calls: p95
spec.description: How long the calls to the model providers take, at the 95th percentile.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-genai" && kind = client && span.server.address != nil } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.server.address)

spec.title: Kept past retention
spec.description: Settled generations still stored after their retention, which the purge deletes every 10 seconds. An alert fires past 30 minutes.

spec.title: Signing keys
spec.description: Each usage's active keys, the age of the newest, and the runway: how long the newest still signs. Rotation keeps the newest younger than its period; an alert fires when the runway drops under 3 days.

spec.title: Tokens signed
spec.description: Each hour's signed tokens by key usage: access tokens (auth) and refresh tokens (auth-refresh), which follow sign-ins.

spec.title: Key rotation runs
spec.description: The hourly rotation job's runs, by outcome.

spec.title: Token verifications refused
spec.description: Tokens Authentication refused to verify, each hour, by key usage: mostly expired tokens, so watch the trend.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "service-authentication" && name = "tokens.ClaimsVerify" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.key.usage)

spec.title: Sign-ins
spec.description: Each hour's sign-ins through the account platform, by step and status. sign-in sends the visitor there and callback brings them back, both with a 303; failed counts the returns that did not complete. Worry when failed follows callback, or at any 5xx.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "platform-studio" && (name = "GET /auth/sign-in" || name = "GET /auth/callback" || name = "GET /(studio)/auth/sign-in/failed") } | count_over_time() by (name, span.http.response.status_code)

spec.title: Pages and data requests
spec.description: Each hour's server renders: full pages, and data requests from pages already open.

spec.title: Calls to the services: p95
spec.description: How long Studio's server waits on each service it calls, at the 95th percentile.

spec.title: Refusals from the services
spec.description: Each hour's calls a service answered with an error status, by service and status: where a visitor's request met a limit or a fault.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "platform-studio" && kind = client && span.http.response.status_code >= 400 } | count_over_time() by (span.server.address, span.http.response.status_code)
